borders.label: 边框 1 - Border 1
borders.description: Divider (`#E0E0E0`): Hairline dividers between list rows and card sections.

borders.label: 边框 2 - Border 2
borders.description: The accent system is the brand's two blues. Booking Blue (`#003580`) — a deep navy — owns the brand surfaces: the top app bar, the Genius loyalty banner, headers, and the logotype. A brighter CTA Blue (`#0071C2`) owns action: the "Search" button, "Reserve", "See availability", links, and selected filters. A warm yellow (`#FEBB02`, lifted from the brand mark and used for star ratings) provides the only non-blue accent. The split is disciplined: navy = brand/structure, bright blue = act, yellow = rating. The most recognizable element is the review-score badge — a small solid-navy rounded rectangle showing a one-decimal score (e.g. `8.9`) next to a word label ("Fabulous"), a Booking.com signature you can spot from across a screen.

borders.label: 边框 3 - Border 3
borders.description: Text Primary (`#1A1A1A`): Property names, prices, titles, primary UI text.

borders.label: 边框 4 - Border 4
borders.description: Booking.com's iOS app is dense, blue, and relentlessly conversion-focused — an information-rich travel marketplace where every screen is engineered to move a traveler from "browsing" to "booked". The canvas is clean white (`#FFFFFF`) with a light gray surface (`#F2F2F2`) chunking the feed into scannable blocks, so the real estate goes to what sells a stay: a big photo, a name, a review score, and a price. Where a lifestyle travel app breathes, Booking.com packs — property cards are tight, stacked with badges ("Genius", "Free cancellation", "Breakfast included"), and every element earns its pixels by nudging the decision forward.

borders.label: 边框 5 - Border 5
borders.description: Blue Tint (`#E7F0F7`): Light wash behind selected filters, info banners, and the selected map pin.

panels.title: 面向真实界面片段
panels.body: 按钮、输入、卡片和间距样例保持克制，便于比较不同主题的系统性差异。

do: 建议：Use clean white ({#FFFFFF}) as the canvas — the marketplace needs density on white。
建议：Use Booking Blue ({#003580}) for brand/structure: app bar, Genius banner, the score badge。
建议：Use CTA Blue ({#0071C2}) for action: Search, Reserve, links, selected filters。
建议：Render the review-score badge as a solid-navy rounded chip with a one-decimal score + word。
建议：Always format the score as {X.X} (one decimal) — {8.9}, never {8.90} or {8}。
dont: 避免：use a tinted or dark canvas — the dense card feed needs white。
避免：blur the blue roles — navy is brand/structure, bright blue is action。
避免：restyle the score badge per screen — its rigid navy + one-decimal format is the brand tell。
避免：show the score as an integer or two decimals — always one decimal。
避免：add accent colors beyond the two blues and the rating yellow。
